Implemented only python/treams_rs/_smatrix.py:

  • Automatic dispatch for SMatrix(...), interface, propagation, slab, and stack.
  • Constant receiver promotion for cascade, bands, power, and scatter.
  • Updated slab documentation to use the ordinary API.

Verified slab transmission gradients agree across Advect, JAX eager/JIT, PyTorch, and Autograd. Additional Advect finite-difference checks passed for constructors, mixed constant/dynamic cascades and stacks, and scattering traced amplitudes. Ruff checks pass. Used the existing native extension; no builds or commits.

Remaining concerns communicated: framework methods lack full legacy/SMatrix parity; __new__ changes class signature introspection; framework cascade keyword needs alignment with root next_layer.

items.html:
Implemented interaction compatibility:

  • Framework TMatrix.interaction() / .solve() / .illuminate() / .factor().solve().
  • Root constant TMatrix.interaction.illuminate(...) promotes traced illumination.
  • Constant cluster ScatteringFactor.scatter(...) preserves illumination derivatives while reusing its native LU factors.

Changed _framework_tmatrix.py, _tmatrix.py’s _Interaction, _cluster.py’s ScatteringFactor.scatter, and added tests/autodiff/test_interaction_dispatch.py.

Verified 76 tests passed, including all four backends, JAX JIT, finite-difference gradients, repeated solves, self-coupling identity, and existing NumPy interaction/cluster coverage. Ruff passes.

Framework .factor() reuses coupling but records a native factorization per solve; documentation explicitly states this difference and absence of manual .record() contexts. Framework Cluster.factor() remains outside this change. No commits.

Added framework Cluster.factor().scatter() with shared derivative code and reusable prepared coupling/blocks. Dynamic factors record a native factorization per scatter; this is documented.

Also fixed raw incident coefficients being incorrectly re-expanded between cluster centres. Added geometry-gradient and repeated vector/batch solve coverage across all four backends.

84 focused tests pass, including JAX JIT and existing NumPy cluster tests. Ruff passes; Pyrefly reports zero errors for both modified implementation files. Code is stable; no commits.
